name: System Shock 2

steam.store_details: The classic 1999 build was delisted from Steam in October 2025; Steam now sells only the 25th Anniversary Remaster.
steam.patches: The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) fixes bugs and polishes the game, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

gog.store_details: The original 1999 build's own GOG listing was delisted in October 2025 — GOG now sells only the 25th Anniversary Remaster — but existing owners of the classic build keep access.
gog.patches: The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) fixes bugs and polishes the game, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

audio_fixes.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Some System Shock 2 maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there (per NewDark's documentation).

extra_fixes.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
extra_fixes.reason: System Shock 2 reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision (per NewDark's documentation).

notes: It comes with NewDark pre-installed, which has its own 'Hardware Acceleration' option in the in-game Audio menu — worth trying if EAX doesn't sound right.
